comment: The jack the panel puts in the hi-hat column is dead: TUNEHH_INPUT is never read. The hi-hat highpass cutoff is instead `params[TUNEHH_PARAM].getValue() + inputs[TUNEBD_INPUT].getVoltage() * 1000`, so the kick's tune jack moves it. PARAMHH_PARAM is declared but never configured and has no widget, so there is no hi-hat drive knob. The FX drive knob is configured 1 to 49 but clamped to 1 to 10 in use. LENGTHS_PARAM maps both hi-hat parts to LENGTHHH_PARAM, so one knob sets both. The manual trigger buttons are rate-limited to sampleRate / 4 while held; CV triggers are not rate-limited, because the guard tests the button's own previous value. The mix output is the sum of the parts divided by the sum of the mix knobs, times 1.5, so it is an average rather than a sum.
